title: Back Office Desk Surfaces - Paperwork and Search Area Context
prompt:
1) Function: Provide a forensic-quality color photograph documenting the back office desk surface and paperwork layout for search-area context.
2) Scene / Composition: Single still image of an office desk surface with scattered generic paperwork (blank letter-sized sheets, a simple unlabeled notepad, a few unmarked envelopes) and a plain black pen, arranged as-found. Include a portion of the desk edge and a small part of the adjacent neutral wall or desktop organizer to give context, but keep the focus on the desk surface; paperwork occupies ~65% of the frame. Use even forensic flash lighting to minimize shadows and reveal texture on paper. No readable personal information; any text present should be nonspecific lorem-ipsum-style and too small/soft to read. No annotations, no scale items, no evidence markers.
3) Angle & Distance: Eye-level view at 0° tilt (level horizon), camera positioned 1.2 m from the center of the desk surface.
4) Optics & Technique: 35 mm lens, f/8, 1/125 s, ISO 200, white balance 5600K; sharp focus across the desk surface with moderate depth of field; forensic flash as key light with diffuse fill to avoid harsh shadows.
5) Mandatory elements: No timestamps, camera labels, zone labels, case identifiers, or written evidence IDs visible anywhere.
6) Negatives: No people, faces, hands, reflections showing a person, or biometrics; no real names, addresses, phone numbers, IDs, signatures, or legible sensitive text; no brands/logos on stationery, pen, or objects; no weapons, drugs, cash, or contraband; no official badges/insignia; no license plates; no rulers/scale bars; no on-image annotations, circles, arrows, or highlighting; no additional screens/devices displaying UI.
7) Acceptance checklist: - Color forensic-quality photo with even flash illumination and minimal shadowing
- Eye-level, level-horizon framing from 1.2 m distance
- Desk surface with generic paperwork covering ~65% of frame plus slight surrounding context
- No readable personal data; any text is nonspecific and not legible
- No scale, no evidence markers, no annotations, no timestamps/labels
- No people, brands, logos, or official insignia
